ModMetaData.name: Entertaining Ideas
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
Thirteen new recreation ideas, spread across the tech ladder, so a colony has something worth doing whether it is chewing pemmican in a hide tent or running an archotech lounge.
- Knucklebone mat (neolithic) - the thinking game a tribe can build on day one. Cast bones, argue, gamble. - Soaking tub (medieval) - a wood-fired barrel colonists get into. Warms the room, steams while the firebox is lit. - Skittles lane (medieval) - five tiles of board and nine pins. Roll from the near end; the pins scatter when the ball arrives. - Shadow lantern theater (medieval) - a lamp, a linen screen, and a drum the flame turns by itself. The shadows walk whether or not anyone is watching, and a whole room can sit and watch them. - Pinball machines (industrial and up) - four themed tables on one 1x3 cabinet frame: the standard machine, the chemfuel-flashpot boomalope blitz, the solid-state mech rampage, and the archotech dreamtable that projects a ball you cannot miss. - Cocktail arcade table (industrial) - a face-up screen under glass with a joystick at each of two seats. The maze game runs while someone is playing it. - Aquarium (industrial) - fish that swim whether or not anyone is watching, and a lot of beauty. - Karaoke machine (industrial) - a crowd of up to five, and practice at handling other people. - Massage chair (industrial) - colonists sit in it, not beside it. Rollers work up the backrest while it runs. - Hologame pod (spacer) - a board of light that tunes itself just past your ability. Trains intellectual. - Vista panel (spacer) - a 3x1 wall display showing somewhere with a horizon in it, running on the local clock: grey dawn, daylight, a long sunset, then stars. It lights the room to match, and colonists in that room hold off cabin fever for longer. - Gravball court (ultratech) - a 3x3 court with the ball held in a lazy orbit, played from the edges by up to four colonists. - Dreamloop holotheater (ultratech) - point it at a wall within six tiles and it throws a moving picture onto that wall. A whole room can watch, bedridden colonists included.
Includes a small assembly for the animated screens, the wall projection, the sit-in furniture and the vista panel. No Harmony and no mod dependencies.
